USB drives and folders, and Last.fm in every build.
Built on [MangoTile 1.0.5](https://github.com/Diffechento/MangoTile/releases/tag/v1.0.5).

**Music on a USB drive, an SD card or any folder** ([#9](https://github.com/Diffechento/MetroMusic/issues/9)).
Settings → library → folders: add a folder with the system picker, or a connected drive in one tap.
The library follows a drive being plugged in and out. All Files Access is optional — with it folders
are read directly, faster, and tag editing and `.lrc` files work there too.

**Last.fm sign-in** ([#10](https://github.com/Diffechento/MetroMusic/issues/10)). A wrong shared
secret is now reported up front instead of leaving the login page open for ever; with a right one the
page closes as soon as access is allowed.

**The F-Droid build has Last.fm built in**, so scrobbling and cover lookup work without a key of your
own.

**Fixed:** editing an album's artist no longer rewrites every track's artist; covers Android cannot
decode are read by the app; a compilation no longer gets one of its singles' covers.

---

The APK carries the same signing certificate as every release since 1.0 (`SHA-256 494018a9…2acf7c09`),
so it installs over any of them as an update. The F-Droid build is signed by F-Droid and does not
install over it.

minSdk 26 · compileSdk 36 · GPLv3 · third-party notices are in the app, on settings → about.
